messages.subject: Order
messages.text:
Please see picture of the disgusting packages I received from you. I did not pay $30.00 for 1 with nothing in it (the one in the middle), 1 with just some dirt in it and a 3rd one with some seeds in it.
 Truly disgusted.
 

 Nancy Greer

messages.subject: Re: Order
messages.text:
Hello Nancy,
 

 We are sorry to hear that your milkweed seeds were damaged during shipping. It is true that, despite the care we take with our shipments, situations like this can occur beyond our control. 
 

 However, to ensure product and service quality and give the milkweed a chance to grow in your garden, we will be reshipping your order. 
 But to ensure that your next shipment arrives in the best possible condition, we would like to offer you a new shipment of dry seeds instead of stratified seeds. Would that be acceptable to you, or would you still prefer to receive stratified seeds?
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay
